title: Data Preparation for ML with S3 [Hands-On]

cues.en: Hello, my friends, and welcome to this new hands-on tutorial on data preparation with S3.
cues.zh: 朋友們好，歡迎來到使用 S3 準備資料的新實作。

cues.en: Indeed, when doing machine learning in AWS, you will oftentimes upload your data in S3 so that you can then feed it into your machinery model,
cues.zh: 在 AWS 做機器學習時，經常先將資料上傳 S3，再送入機器學習模型，

cues.en: whether it is a regression model, a classification model, a time series model, which we will see in further sections.
cues.zh: 不論迴歸、分類，或後續章節會看到的時間序列模型。

cues.en: But yes, uploading the data in S3 is a common practice before training your machine learning model in AWS.
cues.zh: 訓練 AWS 機器學習模型前，上傳資料到 S3 是常見做法。

cues.en: And that's why you absolutely need to know how to do it.
cues.zh: 因此一定需要知道如何做。

cues.en: So very simply, over here in the search bar, we're gonna enter S3, and, of course, we're gonna choose here S3, Scalable Storage in the Cloud.
cues.zh: 很簡單，在搜尋列輸入 S3，選擇 S3，雲端可擴展儲存服務。

cues.en: This will take us to the S3 service, and then you will see how so easy it is to upload the data in S3.
cues.zh: 進入 S3 後，你會看到上傳資料非常簡單。

cues.en: The first step is, of course, to create a bucket which will contain your data.
cues.zh: 第一步當然是建立儲存資料的 bucket，也就是儲存貯體。

cues.en: Here, we're gonna keep general purpose.
cues.zh: 這裡保留 General purpose。

cues.en: Then we have to enter a bucket name, which has to be globally unique.
cues.zh: 接著輸入儲存貯體名稱，必須全域唯一。

cues.en: So we will all start with the same thing saying data preparation with S3, okay?
cues.zh: 大家先使用相同開頭，data-preparation-with-s3，好嗎？

cues.en: And then we're gonna add a dash, and we're all gonna enter different random numbers like that, okay?
cues.zh: 再加連字號，各自輸入不同隨機數字，像這樣。

cues.en: So that we make sure we all have globally unique names.
cues.zh: 確保名稱全域唯一。

cues.en: Okay, data preparation with S3, and then no need to do anything else.
cues.zh: 好，data-preparation-with-s3，其餘不需修改。

cues.en: You know, we can just skip all this configuration, and we can just scroll down.
cues.zh: 可以略過這些設定，直接往下捲。

cues.en: Just note this very important thing, which might be part of the exam.
cues.zh: 注意一個非常重要、可能會考的地方。

cues.en: Whenever you create an S3 bucket, encryption is automatically applied by default.
cues.zh: 建立 S3 儲存貯體時，預設自動套用加密。

cues.en: And you have three encryption types, and we're gonna keep the first one, okay?
cues.zh: 有三種加密類型，保留第一種。

cues.en: And then very simply, we can just click at the bottom-right Create bucket.
cues.zh: 再按右下角 Create bucket。

cues.en: This will create an S3 bucket in which we'll be able to upload whatever data that will be used to train a machine learning model, all right?
cues.zh: 就能建立 S3 儲存貯體，上傳訓練機器學習模型所需的任何資料。

cues.en: So that's the bucket we just created, data preparation with S3, and then very simply to upload some, what we call objects, right, which will be nothing else than a CSV file
cues.zh: 這就是剛建立的 data-preparation-with-s3。接著要上傳所謂的物件，其實就是 CSV，

cues.en: or a tabular file, you know, whatever is used to train your machinery model.
cues.zh: 或表格檔案等，任何用來訓練機器學習模型的資料。

cues.en: Well, very simply, we either click Upload here or Upload there, and we click Add files.
cues.zh: 按這裡或這裡的 Upload，再按 Add files。

cues.en: And this will take us to our local machine, right?
cues.zh: 就會開啟本機檔案選擇視窗。

cues.en: The AWS CMLE folder containing all the datasets and resources was provided to you at the beginning of this course.
cues.zh: 課程開頭已提供 AWS CMLE 資料夾，包含全部資料集與資源。

cues.en: So we're just gonna go inside this folder, AWS CMLE, and then now that we are in the data preparation for machine learning section, well, there we go.
cues.zh: 進入 AWS CMLE，再到 Data Preparation for Machine Learning 章節。

cues.en: I've just added this dataset so far, demand_forecasting.csv, which is a classic dataset used for time series analysis where you have to predict the demand of certain items
cues.zh: 目前只放了 demand_forecasting.csv，這是常見時間序列分析資料集，預測零售商店

cues.en: in a retail store.
cues.zh: 特定商品的需求。

cues.en: I just provided that as an example.
cues.zh: 只是先提供它當例子。

cues.en: And then of course, I will add some more datasets as we progress in this section, okay?
cues.zh: 隨著章節進行，會加入更多資料集。

cues.en: There will be a different dataset used to illustrate what is covered in the tutorial.
cues.zh: 不同資料集用來示範不同教學內容。

cues.en: All right, so demand_forecasting.csv, and then you just click Open, and here, back into the upload feature, you scroll down and you click at the bottom-right, Upload.
cues.zh: 選 demand_forecasting.csv，按 Open，回到上傳畫面，往下捲，按右下角 Upload。

cues.en: Uploading, and upload succeeded.
cues.zh: 正在上傳，上傳成功。

cues.en: Perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: So there we go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: Now you can just click Close, and now back into your data preparation with S3 bucket.
cues.zh: 按 Close，回到 data-preparation-with-s3 儲存貯體。

cues.en: You will find indeed the data in the form of a CSV file, which is considered in S3 as an object, okay?
cues.zh: 可以看到 CSV 資料檔，在 S3 裡視為一個物件。

cues.en: And then nothing else to do in S3.
cues.zh: S3 目前沒有其他事情要做。

cues.en: You will see later on when we reach the moral development section, well, I'll show you how to load the data from S3 before training your machine learning models.
cues.zh: 後面進入模型開發章節，會展示訓練模型前，如何從 S3 載入資料。

cues.en: That will be a very exciting step.
cues.zh: 那會是很精彩的步驟。

cues.en: And at this point, we're all fine with S3, and we can just move on to the next hands-on tutorial.
cues.zh: 目前 S3 都準備好，可以進入下一個實作。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning in AWS.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受 AWS 機器學習的樂趣吧。
